[[File:Boffa_tree.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Boffa trees on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].]]
'''Boffa trees''', also known as '''boffa plants''', were plants that grew on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> Boffa fruits were edible for many [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="YJK:DK">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Darkest Knight]]''</ref> The plant was featured on [[Vanvi Hotne]]'s painting ''[[Boffa Plant]]''.<ref name="SWG:P6">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other}}Publish 6: "The Imperial Crackdown"</ref>
